sem_edx._layout: Which quantities each sheet shows and in what order. 'Ni' is an element, 'Ni:S' a ratio worked out from two. Run data/ETL/03_import_sem_edx_gen4_1.py to see what a workbook holds.

sampling._default_range: Where the QC Sampling tab's range boxes start. Each end is a marking number, or 'oldest' or 'newest' for the first or last electrode on record. Set from the tab itself, Default range.

qc_requests._request_window_days: How far back QC may ask production for an electrode. Production Data Manager lists the last 30 days of finished electrodes, so an older one has no row there to answer on. Their number: keep it in step with @window_days in sql/qc_requests/011.
